title: Generate activity feed route lacks endpoint coverage
reasoning: The route /api/events/activity-feed/generate/ is registered as a network-accessible activity-feed endpoint, but the included linked tests exercise authentication and method behavior for sibling engagement endpoints without any visible coverage for reversing or calling generate-activity-feed. For a route that likely creates or refreshes user activity-feed data, missing endpoint tests leave auth, allowed methods, response contract, and duplicate-generation/idempotency behavior unverified.
recommendation: Add focused API tests for events:generate-activity-feed covering unauthenticated access, allowed HTTP methods, successful authenticated generation, response shape, and repeated calls not creating duplicate or cross-user feed items.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The provided tests cover admin dashboards, analytics, middleware, JWT login tracking, engagement tracking endpoints, and the engagement_report command, but no included excerpt references the generate-activity-feed route or GenerateActivityFeedView.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create an APITestCase that authenticates a user, posts to reverse('events:generate-activity-feed'), asserts the expected status and generated UserActivityFeed records for that user, then posts again and asserts duplicate behavior matches the intended contract. Include unauthenticated and GET cases.
minimumFixScope: Tests only unless the new tests expose a route/view behavior defect.
